# H&L Junk Removal & Hauling Solutions, LLC

> Fully insured junk removal, hauling, and cleanout company based in League City, Texas, serving Galveston County and south Harris County. Free, no-obligation quotes on every job. Call or text 832-425-7749.

H&L Junk Removal & Hauling Solutions, LLC is a locally owned and fully insured junk removal and hauling business. We make getting rid of unwanted items simple and stress free for homeowners and businesses across the Bay Area Houston region. We show up on time, work fast, and clean up after ourselves.

## Common questions (short answers)
- **What areas do you serve?** H&L is based in League City, TX and serves Galveston County and south Harris County, roughly a 20-mile radius. That covers League City, Clear Lake, Webster, Friendswood, Dickinson, Texas City, Galveston, Seabrook, Kemah, Nassau Bay, La Marque, Santa Fe, Bacliff, San Leon, Pasadena, and Pearland.
- **How much does junk removal cost?** Junk removal is quoted per job, free and with no obligation, because price depends on volume, item type, and access. H&L does not publish flat junk removal prices. Call or text 832-425-7749 for a free quote.
- **How much is a dumpster rental?** The 14-yard roll-off is $365 for 1 day, $365 for the whole weekend, $399 for 3 days, or $475 for 7 days. Delivery and haul-off are included and there is no weight or tonnage fee. Extra days past the period you booked are $100 per day.
- **Do you offer same-day service?** Often yes. Same-day and next-day junk removal is usually available in the League City and Bay Area Houston service area.
- **Are you insured?** Yes, H&L is fully insured, and a certificate of insurance is available on request for commercial clients.
- **Do you do the loading?** Yes. For junk removal the crew does all the lifting, loading, and cleanup. For a dumpster rental H&L delivers the can, you fill it on your own time, and H&L hauls it off.
- **What will you not take?** H&L cannot take hazardous materials, which includes paint, solvents, oil, fuel, pesticides, asbestos, and medical waste. Appliances containing refrigerant are accepted and the refrigerant is handled properly.
- **How do I get a quote?** Call or text 832-425-7749, or use the free quote form at https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/free-quote-junk-removal-league-city-tx/. Photos of the items speed it up.
